source_refs.note: Topic 4.1.1.1 List Creation (PDF 91, printed 88). The printed list mixes quote styles and spells 'Balloon'/'Balloons' inconsistently; a cleaned version is carried.

blocks.text: In Python a list is created with square brackets, with items separated by commas. Text items are enclosed in quotes, and print() displays the list. Items can later be added or removed.

blocks.title: Python code (each .... is one 4-space indent)
blocks.text:
# Create a list of items
items = ["Decorations", "Snacks", "Cold drinks", "Plates", "Balloons"]
print(items)
A linked list is a type of list made of nodes, where each node holds a value and a reference to the next node (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: How many items does the list items contain, and what is items[0]?

items: Create a list with [ ] and commas; print() shows it.
